# Addon source snapshots

## Use

Read `../../docs/addon-reuse.md` before adapting these files.
Read `../../docs/requirements.md` before planning addon features.

These are source snapshots and excerpts for the planned addon.
They do not form an installable addon or an active website dependency.
Their original namespaces and some dependencies require adaptation.

## Provenance

`manifest.json` identifies every copied file, its original path, revision, selection, and SHA-256 hash.
Each source directory contains the original MIT license.
Preserve those notices when copying or modifying the source.

Keep these snapshots unchanged. Place adapted code outside this directory and record its source attribution.
